title: Keeping the correct meter
passage:
I thought we were supposed to keep the old meter until Friday.
A. I’ve already taken the reading for today.
B. We are. This is the spare one.
C. Friday’s technician is usually here by nine.
passageZh:
我以為我們得把舊電表留到星期五。
A. 我已經抄好今天的讀數了。
B. 沒錯。這是備用的那個。
C. 星期五的技師通常九點前會到。
